newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures tradeless for third day.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures tradeless for third day.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat futures did not trade for the third successive day on Thursday.
Settlement prices drifted in a narrow range.
One broker, who asked not to be named, described it as a "very disappointing day".
Overseas markets were quiet overnight, contributing to the malaise, while the delivery situation was difficult in Australia, he said.
"No-one's in the market is prepared to take delivery because they could end up having to take it out of the export terminal," he said.
